metadata.description: Official Agent Skills published by the PowerSoftware (powersoftware.app / 幂栈网) team for automating recurring platform operations.

plugins.name: publish-product
plugins.description: End-to-end playbook to publish a software product (license-enabled or not) on PowerSoftware: register → partner human review gate → upload assets → submit. Ships with dependency-free Node 18+ scripts.

plugins.name: integrate-license
plugins.description: Playbook to wire a client software product into the PowerSoftware license system with the official zero-dependency SDK (Node/Python/Java): pick the scenario, fetch the SDK from GitHub at runtime, implement trial/activation/edition-gating, and smoke-test. Ships with dependency-free Node 18+ scripts.

plugins.name: plan-seo-site
plugins.description: Knowledge-only playbook to plan a product site's SEO infrastructure and keyword-driven landing pages with 哥飞's method: one domain + one-level semantic subdirectory + one-page-one-keyword, task-words not attribute-words, keyword KD/referring-domain budget, content i18n & hreflang/canonical checks, trailing-slash & main-domain normalization, and Search Console indexing verification. Includes a repo self-check list and a worked powersoftware.app case.

plugins.name: find-profitable-demand
plugins.description: Demand-first playbook to find, validate and monetize a profitable demand for an indie / 出海 website with 哥飞's 跑通闭环 method: demand-sourcing (站找站·站找词, running-ads mining, big-site traffic split, 财富密码词根, KGR blue-ocean), a hard validation gate (共识搜索量 / 真实网页供应量 / 第一美元 ROI), fast MVP launch, traffic & link paths, AdSense/paid monetization, and a real case library. Decides WHAT to build; plan-seo-site covers HOW to rank it.
